summary: Iteration 8 review — Affirmation step (Page 4) is gated to Day 1 or Mondays, carries over the rest of the week as a banner + on the final page. Inspirational Quote (Page 7) remains ungated on every day. Backend: 12/12 new iter8 pytest pass (4 affirmationDay flag, 3 carriedAffirmation, 2 quote-always, 3 regression). Verified: /api/day for Day 1 → affirmationDay=true; /api/day/2026-09-07 (Monday) → true; /api/day/2026-09-08 (Tue) & 09-12 (Sat) → false. After seeding affirmationSelected='I am calm and focused' on Mon 09-07, Tue/Sat responses return carriedAffirmation exactly equal to Monday's affirmation. affirmationCustom takes precedence over affirmationSelected. Users with no history get carriedAffirmation=''. Quote content is present in both affirmation-day and non-affirmation-day payloads. Regressions green: /api/calendar includes currentStreak/longestStreak/restDayAvailable; /api/gratitude-wall works; PUT /api/day persists. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): (a) Day 1 (fresh user) flow order = mood → affirmation(step 2) → morningRitual → weeklyGoals → blessings → workout → dailyGoals → **Daily Inspiration (step 8, quote)** → yesterday → today → journal → weekly → final (13 steps); affirmation-0 & affirmation-custom testIDs present; final page shows the picked affirmation. (b) Non-affirmation-day: seeded uid with Monday affirmation, opened /flow?date=2026-09-08 (Tue, Day 2 — non-special) → 9 steps total, affirmation step is ABSENT, Quote step 'Daily Inspiration' present at step 5, banner with carried text 'I am calm and focused' appears on all 8 non-excluded steps (mood/blessings/workout/dailyGoals/quote/yesterday/today/journal), final 'Your Affirmation' page shows the carried text. 'Today's Actions' is page 9 per STEP_META (regression pass). No deprecated Expo packages, no red-screen errors. Pre-existing note: 4 iter6 streak-freeze tests still fail (unchanged from prior iterations, unrelated to iter8 feature).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:567 `affirmation_day = day_no == 1 or parse_date(d).weekday() == 0` — Python weekday() Mon=0, correct.

server.py:568-576 carriedAffirmation loop scans up to 400 entries with date<=d, sorted desc — first non-empty affirmationCustom OR affirmationSelected wins. Custom preferred over selected (matches DayEntry precedence used in flow.tsx line 151). Correct.

flow.tsx:97 `if (data?.affirmationDay) s.push('affirmations')` — cleanly gates the step. When false, initial entry hydration on flow.tsx:76-78 seeds affirmationSelected from data.carriedAffirmation so the banner + final page display the carry text via existing affirmationText computed on line 151.

flow.tsx:491 banner exclusion list = {affirmations, final, morningRitual} — banner shows on mood step too, which is not called out in the spec but matches 'appears near the bottom of steps'. Not a bug.
Iteration-6 streak-freeze tests (4 fails, pre-existing) unrelated to this iteration; not introduced by this change.
